page.overview:
What is Fireworks?

Fireworks is an anime-only port town in Paradise where the Fire works Festival is held once a year.

The town has a very basic shape, with mountains at the top. Odama's family workshop is at the top of said mountains. There is also a graveyard near the eastern side of the town where Kodama's parents are buried.

Life on the town revolves around the annual Fire works Festival that takes place when the Straw Hats land. There are many shops and homes near the harbor, but the real focus of the island takes place in the mountainous regions north of there. Odama and his granddaughter Kodama live there, as well as several other Firework Launchers. The family has been making fireworks for 400 years.

For 400 years, Odama's family have made fireworks and launched them in the annual Fire works Festival.
